    SELECT
        c."segment" AS segment,
        SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4) AS year,
        SUM(ym."consumption") AS consumption
    FROM "yearmonth" ym
    JOIN "customers" c ON c."customerid" = ym."customerid"
    WHERE c."currency" = 'EUR'
      AND SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
      AND c."segment" IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c."segment", SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4)
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT
        segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2012' THEN consumption END) AS cons_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN consumption END) AS cons_2013
    FROM yearly
    GROUP BY segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT
        segment,
        ((cons_2013 - cons_2012) / cons_2013) * 100 AS pct_increase
    FROM pivoted
    WHERE cons_2012 IS NOT NULL AND cons_2013 IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT segment, pct_increase
FROM pct
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;


SELECT segment, pct_increase
FROM pct
ORDER BY pct_increase ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;

WITH target_customer AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t."customerid"
    FROM "transactions_1k" t
    WHERE t."price" = 634.8
      AND t."date" = TO_DATE('2012-08-25', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
),

consumption_by_year AS (
    SELECT
        ym."customerid",
        SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ym."date") = 2012 THEN ym."consumption" END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ym."date") = 2013 THEN ym."consumption" END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM "yearmonth" ym
    JOIN target_customer tc ON tc."customerid" = ym."customerid"
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ym."date") IN (2012, 2013)
    GROUP BY ym."customerid"
)

SELECT
    (c.consumption_2012 - c.consumption_2013) / c.consumption_2012 AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM consumption_by_year c;
